Maria K.: heads-up — seeing a spike in inter-region TLS handshake failures between eu-west-1 -> apac-southeast-1 since ~08:15 UTC, started after last night's keystore role change.
Ajay P.: on it. any correlation with keystore-rotator rollout?
Maria K.: yes we rolled RBAC tweak for rotator at 02:40 UTC (limit scope to rotator-sa). logs show 'KMSDecrypt: AccessDenied' from rotator pods around the same time keystore sync started to lag.
Kevin L.: sample from proxy logs: 
```
WARN tls: handshake failed for peer=10.32.4.21 err="remote error: tls: bad certificate" route=ingress-eu
ERROR keystore-sync: decrypt failed key=intermediate/eu err="AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt"
```
Elaine R.: that AccessDenied smells like the new RBAC role didn't include kms:Decrypt for the rotator SA. Could also be a temporary KMS CMK policy mismatch.
Ajay P.: checked IAM policy diff — rotator-sa lost a condition that allowed decrypt for cross-account invocations when we tightened the role. Opening quick PR to re-add kms:Decrypt on the rotator path.
Maria K.: immediate problem is that many proxies still have old certchain pinned, but when keystore sync lags clients with session tickets are failing because ticket keys were rotated out-of-sync. Need graceful fallback plan.
Kevin L.: proposed mitigation: 1) pause automated rotator (prevent more partial rotations) 2) push a manual keystore sync job to all regions 3) temporarily extend session ticket TTL so clients can renegotiate with older keys.
Elaine R.: +1. For (2) I have a kubectl job ready: 
```
kubectl -n infra run keystore-sync --image=redwood/keystore-tools:prod --restart=OnFailure -- env SYNC_TARGET=all
```
Maria K.: I'll run it after a quick smoke test. Also suggest we add an audit-log marker when keystore decrypt fails so SRE can filter these events: new structured log field 'keystore.decrypt_error=true' and include kms_key_id.
Ajay P.: will add the log marker in rotator and keystore-sync code path. Also adding an alert rule: rate(kms_decrypt_errors[5m]) > 5 -> page ops-oncall.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollback initiated for rotator v2.3.1 -> v2.2.8 (requested by Maria K.). :information_source:
deploy-bot: rollback completed in eu-west-1 and us-east-1; apac still rolling back (1/3).
Kevin L.: after rollback, I validated keystore replication from primary to apac — there were ~90s gaps, not huge but enough to cause session-ticket mismatch if rotation happened during that window. Need future-proof: atomic rotation + versioned session ticket keys.
Elaine R.: long-term: implement keystore write-ahead log and per-region reconciliation job; short-term: re-add kms:Decrypt permission and re-run manual sync now, then bump session ticket TTL from 5m -> 30m for 24h.
Maria K.: agreed. Action items: (1) Ajay - PR to add kms:Decrypt + alert (ETA 30m) (2) Elaine - run manual keystore-sync now and bump ticket TTL (ETA 15m) (3) Kevin - open infra ticket for atomic rotation + WAL (INC-1247) (4) Maria - postmortem stub and customer impact check (ETA 2h).
Ajay P.: PR raised: https://git.internal/redwood/keystore/pull/482 — includes log marker + policy change notes.
Maria K.: thanks. if anyone sees new TLS handshakes after the sync please paste a short log line here. :thumbsup:
Kevin L.: quick note: add an audit log entry when we change keystore RBAC in the console; these RBAC tweaks should require a changelog entry to avoid silent regressions.
Elaine R.: noted, adding to follow-up.
Maria K.: closing loop for now. will update thread after sync completes and apac rollback finishes.
